result:
I ran all 14 queries against the input files and each gave a sensible answer. I didn't check L12's answer (alice, bob and carol) against the raw orders.

qlang has no `trim`, so L9 and L10 strip spaces by splitting on `" "`, dropping the empty pieces and joining back with `""`. That is safe here because no value has an internal space. It also treats a line like `  # indented comment` as a comment, as the task requires.

L1: filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * (/items * (mul (at :qty | coalesce 0) (at :price | coalesce 0)) | sum) | sum | round 2
L2: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | * (at :labels | coalesce []) | flat | groupBy * count
L3: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * filter ~(startsWith "^0.") | * keys | flat | distinct | * keyword | sort
L4: /data/users | filter ~(/active | eq true) | filter ~(at :email | ne null) | * (/email | lower) | distinct | sort
L5: /services | :s / | filter ~(at :enabled | coalesce true | eq true) | filter ~(at :port | ne null) | keys | * (:k / | {:name (keyword) :port (s | at k | /port)}) | sort ~/port
L6: lines | * split " " | filter ~(and (/1 | eq "GET") (/3 | eq "200")) | * (/4 | split "ms" | first | parseJson) | :v / | v | sum | div (v | count) | round 1
L7: lines | drop 1 | * split "," | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/1 | lower) * (:g / | * (/2 | parseJson) | sum | div (g | count) | round)
L8: groupBy ~(/user) * count | :m / | keys | * (:k / | {:u (keyword) :c (m | at k)}) | sort ~([(/c | mul -1) /u]) | take 3 * ([/u ":" (/c | print)] | join "")
L9: "Apple, banana, apple , Cherry, banana, apple, date" | split "," | * (split " " | filter ~(count | gt 0) | join "" | lower) | distinct | sort | join "|"
L10: lines | * (split " " | filter ~(count | gt 0) | join "") | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | * split "==" | indexBy ~(/0 | lower) * /1
L11: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | filter ~(at :assignee | eq null) | sort ~([(/comments | mul -1) /number]) | take 2 * /number
L12: groupBy ~(/customer) | filter ~(count | gte 2) | keys | * keyword | sort
L13: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") * (* /name | sort)
L14: filter ~(/type | eq "push") | filter ~(at :payload | coalesce {} | at :repo | coalesce {} | at :name | ne null) | * /payload/repo/name | distinct | sort
